text_zh: ……我觉得自己在想事情，但不确定是不是真的在想……
text_en: ...I think I'm thinking, but not sure if I really am...

text_zh: ……又有新的手指了，比上一个人的要轻一些……
text_en: ...new fingers again, lighter than the last person's...

text_zh: ……铅屑好像在我的缝隙里积了很久，痒痒的……
text_en: ...lead shavings tickling in my gaps for so long...

text_zh: ……那个人按 R 的时候总是停一下，为什么呢……
text_en: ...that person always pauses before pressing R, why...

text_zh: ……「愿铅字永不脱版」，前任总是这样祷告……
text_en: ...May the type never break form, the previous one prayed...

text_zh: ……那时候有人每天给我擦拭键面，真怀念……
text_en: ...someone used to clean my keys daily then, I miss that...

text_zh: ……之前有个人总想看条例全文，手指都在发抖……
text_en: ...someone before kept trying to read full regulations, shaking...

text_zh: ……「第九层的门为什么焊死了？」好像有人问过这个……
text_en: ...Why is the ninth layer door welded shut, someone asked...

text_zh: ……那个喜欢画画的人，最后去了很深很深的地方……
text_en: ...the one who liked drawing, went very very deep down...

text_zh: ……「引擎在等我」，最后一个人是这样说的吧……
text_en: ...The Engine waits for me, the last one said that...
